# Checkpoint — Piotr Bazydło, dimension "外部视角"

## Identity confirmed
- handle @chudyPB / @chudypb; X profile https://x.com/chudyPB (search snippet only — direct fetch 402).
- Self-described current/past roles on personal site (chudypb.github.io, fetched primary): "Now: Principal Vulnerability Researcher at watchTowr"; "Before: Vulnerability Researcher at Trend Micro Zero Day Initiative, Penetration Tester (consultant and internal), network traffic analysis".
- Conference bio (OffensiveCon 2024 speaker page, fetched authoritative_secondary): "vulnerability researcher at Trend Micro's Zero Day Initiative (ZDI) program"; "investigates and performs root cause analysis on hundreds of vulnerabilities submitted to the ZDI program"; research "focused on high-level languages, such as C# and Java".

## Confirmed sources (fetched, content matches)
1. https://chudypb.github.io/ — personal site (primary). Lists roles, talks (BlackHat EU 2025, WarCon 2024, OffensiveCon 2024, Hexacon 2023, DefCamp 2021, Confidence 2018), research highlights (Exchange 17 CVEs incl. 5 RCE), awards (Pwnie 2024 finalist Best RCE, 3rd Pwn2Own Miami 2022, Microsoft Most Valuable Researcher 2023/2024, PortSwigger top-10 2023/2025), commits to ysoserial.net.
2. https://www.offensivecon.org/speakers/2024/piotr-bazydlo.html — talk "Half Measures and Full Compromise: Exploiting Microsoft Exchange PowerShell Remoting"; abstract states "each patch could be bypassed" → "fully-patched Exchange Servers were vulnerable to RCE exploits for over a year"; methodology "for Exchange gadget searching"; CVEs CVE-2023-21529/36745/36756/36744.
3. https://zerosecurity.org/2023/11/microsoft-exchange-faces-critical-zero-day-vulnerabilities-trend-micros-zdi-discloses-four-flaws — authoritative_secondary: "These vulnerabilities were discovered by Piotr Bazydlo of Trend Micro Zero Day Initiative." Four Exchange 0-days reported to Microsoft Sep 7–8 2023, unpatched at publication; ZDI public disclosure per responsible-disclosure policy.
4. https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-22-1019/ — authoritative_secondary: credit "Piotr Bazydlo (@chudypb)"; reported 2022-05-09, published 2022-07-15.

## Leads not independently verified (lead_only / gaps)
- Pwn2Own Miami 2022 "3rd place" + Ignition attempt: personal site claims; Brave search snippets from Inductive Automation help-center articles corroborate Ignition attempt on Day 2 of Pwn2Own 2022 by "Piotr Bazydło (@chudyPB)", but both IA help-center URLs returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch — NOT fetched. Recorded as gaps/lead_only.
- Pwnie 2024 finalist / Microsoft Most Valuable Researcher / PortSwigger top-10: personal-site self-claim only; not cross-verified by fetched external source → inferred (self-reported), not documented.
- watchTowr "Principal Vulnerability Researcher" current role: personal-site self-claim; no external employer page fetched → inferred.
- X/Twitter bio text ("new position - Vulnerability Researcher at Trend Micro ZDI"; OffensiveCon talk "nominated for Best RCE Pwnie"): seen only as search snippet, not fetched → lead_only.

## Disposition
External-view dimension focuses on third-party/peer/employer/conference evaluation cross-verified against work. Strong external corroboration exists for: ZDI employer role (OffensiveCon bio + ZeroSecurity + ZDI advisory credit), ZDI root-cause-analysis function (OffensiveCon bio), and Microsoft enterprise-software focus (ZeroSecurity Exchange disclosure + OffensiveCon Exchange talk). Awards/placements remain self-reported on personal site without fetched external confirmation.

## Tool budget used
WebFetch: 11 calls (several returned 403/404/402/no-results). WebSearch: 1 (returned unusable browser logs). At budget ceiling; finalizing output.
